fix: In Carex (and Cyperaceae floras) 'utricle' is the perigynium, not the utricle fruit type PO_0030097; map 'utricle' to perigynium when the taxon is Carex/Kobresia or the text has nutlets enveloped by it.
reason: The style is indeed shorter than the 'utricle', but here the utricle is the Carex perigynium enclosing the nutlet, so the comparison target class is wrong.
Filaments usually longer than calyx; bearer, quality, target and frequency qualifier match.
Stems sometimes ± glabrate: stem glabrescent with approximate qualifier.
Umbels 5- or 6-flowered: 5 or 6 flowers per inflorescence, container recorded.
Capsules tardily dehiscent: the fruit is dehiscent; 'tardily' adds timing but the statement stays true.
Leaf blade lanceolate or oblong.
Second dimension of L × W: blade width 2–3(–4.5) cm.
Dense fibrous adventitious roots: fibrous-rooted, allowed on root.
Peduncle longer than the leaves.

fix: Qualities in a run after 'blade' (shape; size; texture) belong to the blade until the next part noun; the pipeline fell back to the leaf heading.
reason: 'subleathery' follows 'blade lanceolate ..., 5-10 × 0.5-1.5 cm' and is said of the blade.

fix: 'not conspicuously X' negates the degree (conspicuousness), not X itself; read as inconspicuously X or skip, never as absence of X.
reason: Piper blades are gland-dotted; the flora says only the dots are not conspicuous, not that the blade lacks them.
Inflorescences 4–6 cm wide.
Seeds numerous: present, amount many.
Ligule margin without cilia: ligule not ciliate (ciliate is a margin quality).
Stipules fused with the leaves; the 8–70 mm fusion length is not captured but nothing stated is false.
Leaves broadly obovate to almost circular, a shape continuum.
Flowers numerous.

fix: A colour followed by 'inside'/'within' must fill the place slot (inner surface); without it the colour is read as the outside colour.
reason: The follicles are orange or bright red inside; the annotation makes the whole fruit orange/red.

fix: The FloraGabon section heading 'Reticulum' names the bearer (the vein network); do not substitute the leaf.
reason: It is the reticulum of veins and veinlets that is very visible on both faces, not the leaf.
Petiole 2–9 cm long.
Stamens slightly shorter than tepals.
Basal leaf faces abaxially tomentose; abaxial surface substitution is right.

fix: 'apex ± concave' after a fruit description is a concave apex, not a concave fruit; 'apex' should trigger a bearer_scope on the fruit as it does for leaves.
reason: Only the apex of the fig is concave; the fig itself is globose to pyriform.
Pedicel shorter than corolla.

fix: 'absent(es) lors de la floraison' / 'absent at flowering' must fill the stage slot; the plant is not leafless.
reason: Leaves are absent at flowering time (hysteranthous), not absent from the plant.

fix: Hyphenated division compounds (pinnate-pinnatifid, pinnate-bipinnatifid, bipinnate-pinnatifid) give the division at successive orders of one leaf, not a range between two values; do not read the hyphen as 'to'.
reason: 'pinnate-bipinnatifid' means the lamina is pinnate with bipinnatifid pinnae, not a continuum from pinnate to bipinnatifid.
Glumes subequal: approximately equal in size.
Stamens just exceeding the pistil: longer than the pistil.
Sepals glabrous to densely puberulent (outside, implied by the following 'inside' clause); the continuum is right.
Leaf blade apex acuminate.
